title: Annual report.
bodyText: The center shall submit a report on its activities to the legislature at least twenty days prior to the convening of each regular legislative session.
bodyHtml: [§613-4]  Annual report.  The center shall submit a report on its activities to the legislature at least twenty days prior to the convening of each regular legislative session. [L 1989, c 346, pt of §2; am L 1991, c 131, §1]
